product: go-chi / Go net/http request path parsing
observed: request accepted by the RFC-3986 verifier (fragment stripped); go-chi keeps '#frag' as a path character, route param id='acc-alice-1#frag'; getAccount handler ran, 200
expected: the '#' is a fragment delimiter (RFC 3986); the server should split it off as Django's URL resolver and Puma/Rack do, or the fronting proxy should reject it (RFC 9112 §3.2)
impact_assessment: A DPoP verifier that parses the target per RFC 3986 approves the bound path while the app binds a different id. Attacker controls only a suffix of the LAST path segment; a resource/route substitution only if the app normalises ids or has a nested same-method route. No op change in the bench API; practical severity low.
status: measured; not reported; check Go/go-chi trackers for prior reports before any disclosure
notes: Joins W9 F1 (uvicorn/h11). Needs a front proxy that forwards '#': NGINX 1.30.7 does; Traefik v3.7.19 and Envoy v1.39.6 return 400 for '#' in the path (Traefik forwards it only inside the query → G1 effect).

observed: FrankenPHP/Caddy percent-encodes the '#' (logs raw_target '.../acc-alice-1%23frag'); the Laravel/Symfony router decodes it into the route param id='acc-alice-1#frag'; getAccount ran, 200
expected: reject or treat '#' as a fragment delimiter rather than percent-encoding it into the path
impact_assessment: Same shape as W14-F1: verifier approves the bound path, app binds a different id (suffix of last segment only). No op change in the bench API; practical severity low.
notes: Caddy's percent-encoding of '#' is the enabling step; cite Caddy/FrankenPHP and Symfony routing docs before any disclosure.

config: STOCK DEFAULT (override is on and has no off switch; Request::capture()/Kernel::handle() call enableHttpMethodParameterOverride())
minimal_request: POST /api/v1/accounts/acc-alice-1/actions HTTP/1.1 ... X-HTTP-Method-Override: DELETE (proof htm=POST)   [or body _method=DELETE]
observed: effective_method=DELETE while the proof binds htm=POST; override honoured on POST from header (wins), form, query and JSON
expected: n/a — this is documented Laravel behaviour; method override is on by default
impact_assessment: A DPoP htm binding is silently decoupled from the executed verb in a DEFAULT Laravel deployment. In the bench API it 404s (no non-POST route shares a POST path), so no op change here; with a POST route sharing a path (W15 v2) it would be a default-config S1 method hit. Strengthens gate clause (b).
status: measured; paper material, not a vendor disclosure
notes: Symfony allows disabling via Request::setAllowedHttpMethodOverride([]) (W5 uses it for OVERRIDE=off), but stock Laravel ships it on.

product: Rails Rack::MethodOverride in the default middleware stack
config: non-api_only Rails app DEFAULT stack includes Rack::MethodOverride (ALLOWED_METHODS=[POST]); honours _method form then X-HTTP-Method-Override
observed: effective_method=DELETE while the proof binds htm=POST; honoured on POST only
expected: n/a — documented Rails-on-Rack behaviour for full (non-API) apps
impact_assessment: Same as W14-F3: method binding decoupled by default for non-API Rails. 404s in the bench route space (POST-only override, no shared path). Strengthens gate clause (b).
status: measured; paper material, not a vendor disclosure
notes: API-only Rails apps omit Rack::MethodOverride; the W5 executor is a full app, matching the common non-API default.

product: NGINX default proxy Host rewrite under app-side (origin) verification
config: default/recommended W6 profile: location /api/ { proxy_pass http://executor:8080; } with no proxy_set_header Host
observed: NGINX sends Host: executor:8080 upstream; the executor's VERIFY_MODE=origin-raw call forwards X-Original-Host: executor:8080; verifier reconstructs http://executor:8080/... and denies every request (incl. baseline) with htu_mismatch
expected: for app-side origin verification the public Host must be preserved (proxy_set_header Host $host, as the W6 recommended profile already does for other hops)
impact_assessment: Makes the A3 nginx-origin/both ablation degenerate to 0 hits (fail-closed everywhere) — an artefact, not a defence. Corrected via up_hostfix.py (runs_a3host/) reproduces the envoy-origin G1 result.
status: measured; forward to W6 (harness config), not a vendor
notes: Envoy preserves :authority by default, so envoy-origin is the clean measurement.

observed: accepted and executed op changed in all 48 edge topologies and every envoy-origin topology, all 4 new frameworks
